title: Nx failed run output tail
description: Schema-first contract of the output tail of one Nx invocation. Nx does not hand a failed task's output back to its caller, it streams it to the standard output and error of the `nx` process, so the repo adapter keeps the last `maximumTailCharacters` characters of everything that process printed (in arrival order, stdout and stderr together) and, when the invocation failed, classifies that tail like the Bazel lane classifies the tail of a failed action: a task that yielded because its implementation is outdated ends the invocation with the stale implementation error (the outermost command starts again), a task whose inputs were edited while it ran makes the lane run the invocation again (the `build` layer of the churn policy; Nx's own cache makes the rerun execute only the tasks that did not finish).

Policy.description: Authored numbers. `maximumTailCharacters`: the bounded tail kept per invocation.
